- Commit under test: `3f2c74529` (`fix(queue): isolate and rebase saved settings drafts`), based on PR #3538's previously checked head `127539fa0a157d98ffad1da4c4a632e00f9547bd`.
- Environment: Windows worktree `C:\Users\DrSapaev\.codex\worktrees\aqs-t02-settings-state\final`; branch `codex/aqs-T02-queue-settings-state`.

- Original review findings: a persisted whole-settings draft could overwrite newer server settings; drafts were not bound to the signed-in principal or cleared at logout; a late save showed success while later edits remained unsaved; a throwing `sessionStorage.removeItem` could prevent refresh.
- Resolution: version 2 drafts store their owner ID, base settings, and draft settings. A server/base mismatch keeps the current server snapshot visible and blocks Save until the administrator explicitly applies the draft changes or discards it; applying overlays only fields changed from the stored base. Auth teardown clears both v1 and v2 draft keys. Save completion reports pending unsaved edits as a warning. Draft reads/writes/removals use defensive helpers, and confirmed refresh bypasses stored draft restoration.

## T11 PR #3639 read-only code review — 2026-10-09T13:08+05:00

- Commit under review: PR #3639 exact HEAD `44d0de7b639367de40cc685679fdab94c6611107`, base `6315c62edb888bb8864928a41dd70a4c00be6e3d`. Review was static/read-only across the PR diff; no runtime files were changed and no formal GitHub review was submitted.

- **P1 — duplicate queue-tag profile can bypass the inactive target parent.** In `backend/app/services/qr_queue/_tokens.py` around lines 245–272 and `backend/app/services/queue_svc/_operations.py` around lines 1040–1064, existing-token visibility is accepted when any profile candidate matching the DailyQueue's tag is visible. QueueProfile tags are not unique; `backend/tests/integration/test_queue_profile_lifecycle.py` deliberately configures two profiles sharing a tag. If the target profile is unavailable because its Department is off but a second profile with the same tag remains available, token info/join can still pass through that sibling. The exact-tag regression covers only a unique target tag, so it misses the overlap. This is a code-path finding, not a staging-observed failure. Needs a focused regression and fail-closed resolution for ambiguous target tags.
- **P2 — doctor pagination precedes eligibility filtering.** In `backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/qr_queue/_specialists.py`, `offset/limit` are applied to active Doctors before the profile/parent eligibility mapping. The handler then returns `total=len(specialists_list)` for only that filtered slice. A page filled with Doctors whose profiles are unavailable/unmapped can report zero and hide eligible Doctors on later rows. The endpoint is consumed by `frontend/src/api/queue.ts::fetchAvailableSpecialists`. Needs a regression with ineligible rows before an eligible Doctor and pagination after eligibility (or equivalent continuation/count semantics).
- Other review checks: the QueueProfile resolver fails closed on missing/conflicting parent references and batch-loads Departments; department toggles preserve manual profile state; direct joins and old-token paths re-read parent availability. No schema changes or pending review comments were found.
